<codebase path="packages/config">
  <section priority="medium" role="vitest">
  <file path="vitest/base.d.ts">
    <item priority="high">
      type CoverageConfig = NonNullable<NonNullable<ViteUserConfig["test"]>["coverage"]>;
    </item>
    <item priority="low">
      interface CoverageThresholds {
        lines?: number;
        branches?: number;
        functions?: number;
        statements?: number;
      }
    </item>
    <item priority="low">
      interface VitestCoverageOptions {
        include: string[];
        exclude: string[];
        thresholds: CoverageThresholds;
        reporter?: CoverageConfig["reporter"];
      }
    </item>
    <item priority="low">
      interface VitestPresetOptions {
        environment?: "node" | "jsdom";
        globals?: boolean;
        include?: string[];
        coverage: VitestCoverageOptions;
        extend?: ViteUserConfig;
      }
    </item>
  </file>
  </section>
</codebase>
